description: Get the content of a Google Slides presentation. Returns slide objectIds, placeholder types (TITLE/BODY/SUBTITLE), and text content — stripped of layout/styling data to fit context windows. Use the returned objectIds with slides_batch_update for edits.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

presentation_id.description: The Google Slides presentation ID (from the URL)

name: gws-mcp__slides_get
